concerns.text: FR-003 requires correctness via "translate the original Python unit tests to JavaScript, execute them against the generated JavaScript code." T006/T007 implement empirical I/O-pair extraction with synthetic inputs instead. This is a silent requirement substitution — the spec was never amended to authorize the I/O-pair methodology, so the tasks weaken FR-003 as written. Either update spec FR-003/US-3 to the I/O-pair methodology or add tasks implementing translated unit tests.

Constitution VII mandates correctness "exclusively via the unit-test pass/fail outcomes described in the methodology sketch" and requires any deviation to be "documented in a separate changelog file and justified in the final manuscript." No task creates this changelog, and T012 does not include the justification. Add a task (or extend T012) to write the required deviation changelog.

T007 claims validation_results.csv conforms to translation_result.schema.yaml, but the schema requires generated_js, complexity_score, lines_of_code, raw_response, seed, timestamp as mandatory fields, while T007's declared columns are only snippet_id, condition_name, test_pass_status, execution_time. The task's deliverable falls short of the contract it claims to satisfy — either the task must emit the full schema or the contract must be revised.

FR-001 requires downloading and filtering from BOTH "the CodeTrans and BigCode datasets." T001 fetches only codeparrot/code-trans-py-js with vague "supplemental CodeTrans splits"; no task touches the BigCode dataset named in the spec's assumptions. Partial coverage of a MUST-level FR.

T009 permits Ollama substitution "if the plan's N=10 equivalence check is executed and recorded," but no task implements the N=10 equivalence verification sub-study, the model_source column, or the Phase-6 model-source stratification the plan mandates when fallback is used. If fallback is authorized, its verification machinery must be tasked; otherwise forbid it outright.

Constitution III requires datasets to be checksummed with checksums "recorded under data/". The tasks document explicitly declines to task any checksum step ("platform-owned state hashing"), and no task writes checksums under data/. The plan's checksum_artifacts.py mechanism is dropped without a spec/constitution amendment. Add a task recording SHA-256 checksums under data/ (distinct from platform-owned state/).

Constitution VII prescribes chi-square for correctness and ANOVA for quality. T010's primary analysis is a binomial GLMM with McNemar/chi-square only as a convergence-failure fallback, and no changelog documenting this deviation from the prescribed tests is tasked (same changelog gap as the FR-003 substitution).

T009 defers to "the plan's mid-run checkpoint," but the plan's checkpoint is literally "[deferred]" (undefined trigger point). The task inherits an unexecutable constraint; the checkpoint must be concretely defined in the task or plan.
